sentences.show: On this day in 1066, the Viking Age ended at a bridge in Yorkshire. Or so they say.
Harald Hardrada, King of Norway, had invaded England with hundreds of ships.
Fighting at his side was the English king's own brother, Tostig.
But King Harold marched 185 miles, in just four days.
The Vikings never saw him coming.
At the bridge, one Viking with an axe held back the whole English army.
He cut down more than forty men, until a soldier floated under the bridge, and speared him through the planks.
By the end, Hardrada and Tostig were both dead.
Nineteen days later, he died at Hastings, and William the Conqueror took the crown.
Every day has a story like this.
